name: Alustriel’s Mooncloak

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Moonlight in a 20-foot Emanation gives you and allies Half Cover and resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Radiant. End the spell either as a Reaction to succeed on a failed save against Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained, or as a Magic action to heal yourself or an ally in the area for 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier.
